answer: Per-identity liveness gate: each agent repeats a timed uniqueness challenge every epoch, proving a fresh human signal, not a one-time deposit. Cost is super-linear: one identity costs $4, but a farm of 50 sharing hardware trips correlation checks, forcing isolated rigs that push total cost to $9,800, not $200. Like a tide eroding sand under a ledge, timing drift exposes the cluster. Failure mode: saffron-market gig solvers at $0.60/solve cap near 40/hour, so sustaining 50 identities needs 1.25 solver-hours per epoch, forever.
